explication: GitHub Profile README Generator is a client-side Next.js tool. A user fills staged profile, links, social, and skills forms; validated data is autosaved locally, transformed into Markdown, previewed, copied, or downloaded. Optional GitHub autofill, badges, statistics, dynamic blog references, analytics consent, and support links extend the main flow. The graph reflects sampled calls and README-documented capabilities; several optional integrations are shown without asserting unsampled internal call chains.
